title: Use the LDA app
subtitle: LDA 2.0 · Scan, review, export and restore

scenes.title: Start with a document
captions: Add a document, review what should be hidden, then save a redacted copy.

scenes.title: Ready out of the box
captions: LDA V4 is included. There is no model to download before your first scan.

scenes.title: Scan on your Mac
captions: Choose a document, then click Scan Document. Detection and redaction run on this Mac.

scenes.title: Check the findings
scenes.action: Read the original and the preview
captions: Review the detected names and contact details. Protect any sensitive text the scan missed.

scenes.title: You decide what stays
scenes.action: Switch off only what is safe to share
captions: Turning an item off keeps it visible. Safe Preview shows the change immediately.

scenes.title: Keep private details hidden
captions: In this example, we turn protection back on before exporting the document.

scenes.title: Check the redacted copy
captions: Read Safe Preview before sharing. The same company keeps the same placeholder throughout.

scenes.title: Export for your AI app
captions: Choose Export for AI… to save a Markdown file. Keep the matching .ldamap file on this Mac.
Upload only the reviewed, redacted file. Ask your AI app to preserve every placeholder exactly.

scenes.title: Bring the answer back
captions: Save the AI result as a file. This example summary keeps the placeholders unchanged.

scenes.title: Restore locally
captions: Open Restore and choose the returned file. LDA uses the matching local mapping.

scenes.title: Review the restored values
scenes.action: Original values return on this Mac
captions: Check the restored values before saving. Correct anything that needs attention.

scenes.title: Save a new copy
captions: Choose an output format and save a new copy. Review every export before sharing it.

title: Connect LDA through MCP
subtitle: LDA 2.0 · Your AI workstation, with Codex as the example

scenes.title: Connect your AI workstation
scenes.action: MCP setup, with Codex as the example
captions: LDA 2.0 connects to supported AI apps through MCP. This walkthrough uses Codex.

scenes.title: Save the setup script
captions: Keep LDA.app in Applications. Open Settings, choose AI assistants, and select Codex.
Choose Save Setup Script, then open the saved file locally in Terminal.

scenes.title: Restart and check
captions: Restart your AI app so it loads the connection. Check that LDA appears in its MCP settings.
Ask the assistant to run LDA’s connection check, attest, before starting.

scenes.title: Give a clear instruction
captions: Choose the LDA skill from the slash-command menu, or use $lda in Codex.
Ask for the work you need. You can choose a Matter locally without naming it in chat.

scenes.title: Choose files on your Mac
captions: LDA opens a local document picker. Choose the files there instead of attaching originals to chat.
Optional local PII review lets you inspect or add protection before the AI receives text.

scenes.title: Work with redacted text
captions: The assistant works with the redacted text. Check its answer and any detection-coverage warnings.
Keep every placeholder unchanged so the result can be restored correctly.

scenes.title: Restore and export locally
captions: For a result based on one document, ask LDA to restore it locally and export it.
Review the saved result on your Mac. Keep each document paired with its own mapping.

scenes.title: A simple boundary
captions: Keep originals, mapping files and passwords out of chat. Review redacted text before sharing.
